question: What are the best alternatives to the ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station?
query: best alternatives ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station 2026 comparison Belkin Anker UGREEN

replays.text:
The **closest match is the UGREEN Nexode 100W with 15W MagSafe charging station**. It combines MagSafe charging with 100W GaN power and extra USB ports, making it a good pick if you want to charge a laptop and phone from one compact hub. The trade-off: it **doesn’t have a built-in Apple Watch charger**. [iMore’s review](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)

Other good options, depending on what matters most:

- **Anker 3-in-1 Cube with MagSafe** — Best if you want a compact Apple-device charger: it has a MagSafe charging spot, a retractable Apple Watch charger and a place for AirPods. It’s less suited to replacing the ESR as a high-power laptop charger. [iMore’s picks](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
- **Anker 737 MagGo 3-in-1 Station** — A good all-in-one desk or nightstand option for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods, with 15W MagSafe charging. The drawback is its bulk. [iMore’s picks](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
- **Belkin BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1** — Consider it if you mainly need an elegant iPhone-and-Apple-Watch stand and don’t need the ESR’s extra charging ports or AirPods charging. [iMore’s picks](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)

**Bottom line:** Choose the **UGREEN** for laptop-charging power, or the **Anker Cube** if charging your Watch and AirPods together matters more than 100W USB-C output.

The best alternative depends on what you want to keep from the ESR’s mix of MagSafe, Apple Watch charging, and 100W USB-C power:

- **Closest match for laptop and phone charging: [UGREEN Nexode 100W with 15W MagSafe](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one).** It has 100W GaN charging, a MagSafe phone stand, and extra USB ports in a compact unit. The key trade-off: **no built-in Apple Watch charger**.
- **Best if you want iPhone, Watch, and AirPods charging together: [Anker 3-in-1 Cube](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands).** It has a retractable Apple Watch charger and a spot for AirPods, but it’s not as capable as the ESR for charging a MacBook and phone quickly.
- **Best for a stylish iPhone-and-Watch stand: [Belkin BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands).** A good pick if you don’t need AirPods charging or the ESR’s extra USB ports.
- **Another full 3-in-1 option: [Anker 737 MagGo 3-in-1 Station](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands).** It offers 15W MagSafe charging plus Apple Watch and AirPods charging; the downside is that it’s bulky.

**My quick pick:** UGREEN if 100W wired charging is the priority; Anker Cube if charging all three Apple devices matters more than laptop power.
